Though Yuusuke takes the change in stride, his three hormone-driven friends see this as the true beginning of their youth.

187787.overview: Gran Turismo 3 Autobacs Replay Theater is a demo edition offered by Autobacs in Japan.

188502.overview:
This special version of Gran Turismo 4 enables players to try out the Prius in its newly released incarnation as well as its past models. A play-through of the game apparently reveals just how much improved the new model is, with better cornering and speed, and an overall different feel between the two models.

In addition to a standard time attack race, the Prius Trial Version enables players to race around a track attempting to conserve fuel at all points. At the end of the race, the game reveals where you wasted gasoline while racing. We're not sure if this is a mode that will be in the final game, or if it was something SCE cooked up to show off the fuel savings of the hybrid-engine Prius car. (Toyota also develops a limited-issue hydrogen-powered TOYOTA FCHV feul-cell hybrid vehicle, but that's a different story.)

188588.overview: An European special release based on the First Preview build, featuring here BMW's then-new 1 Series, this version was used to promote them, even including a little video showcasing them and a demo replay around the Nurburgring before the title screen even appears. There are three tracks, the Nürburgring, New York, and Costa di Amalfi, all with a time limit of 180 seconds (3 minutes).

188740.overview:
The Mazda MX-5 Edition demo of Gran Turismo 4 was given as a prize in the Mazda Zoom-Zoom Live event held in 2005. This demo, unlike every other Gran Turismo 4 demo before it, is built off the final game and was built around a month after the US build date, with GT4.VOL reporting a build date of February 21st, 2005. Unlike any other Gran Turismo demo before it, the game's settings are fully adjustable, just as they are in the final game, to the extent that you can run the game in 480p or 1080i display modes. Photo Mode is also fully available.

You are given the choice to either drive in a single opponent race or in a time trial on Mazda Raceway Laguna Seca, Tsukuba Circuit or Côte d'Azur in a 2005 Mazda MX-5 (NC generation), which was a brand new model at the time, although it is possible the car featured in-game is a pre-production or auto show presentation model as it is marked as a concept car. As in the final game, you can race in either mode in A-spec or B-spec modes and unlike any other Gran Turismo demo, there is no default time limit.

190612.overview: Released a couple of months before the final game as both a standalone demo and with a magazine, the Gran Turismo 4 First Preview demo showcases a build of Gran Turismo 4 in a significantly more final state than all of the demos before it.

194094.overview: Last game of the franchise to be ported from the Arcade, GuitarFreaks & DrumMania V3 brings more of the same: a huge list of songs, precise controls (specially using the guitar controller, but playable using the standard PS2 controller as well), and the option to play drums and guitar (including bass).

194348.overview: Second installment of the "V" series on the PlayStation 2. It features more than 60 songs, including some recorded exclusively for the domestic release.

196688.overview: Gallop Racer Inbreed is a Sports game, developed and published by Tecmo, which was released in Japan in 2006.

197196.overview: "Guitar God" for the PlayStation 2 is a highly popular, fan-made custom mod series for Guitar Hero II. Created by modders like W.D., these custom ISO patches replace the game's original tracklist with high-difficulty heavy metal, rock, and anime songs.

197405.overview:
Monster Hunter G is an expanded version of the original Monster Hunter that includes the G rank, a first in the series. G rank quests add more challenging Subspecies of existing monsters, as well as better armor and weapons. The expanded content also includes an extra area, the Battleground, as well as the Training School.

Monster Hunter is a third-person action game set in a kind of pre-historic fantasy world. Many of the creatures you'll see are very similar to dinosaurs, ancient relatives to modern day animals such as boars and insects, and even dragons. Next to a singleplayer mode, the game can also be played online. You can have a hunting party of up to four people, and once you start to go after larger prey, you'll definitely need them all. Every couple of weeks, Capcom organizes online missions. While some are harder than others, they all allow you the chance to create equipment you'd never be able to get if you only played offline.

202465.overview: Coming over from the PSP, Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City stories created all new adventures, characters and a completely new stories in the wildly popular Liberty and Vice Cities. Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories is an all-new, epic adventure set in Liberty City, the 3-island metropolis from Grand Theft Auto 3. The original storyline and all new missions take place in Liberty City, featuring the interactive, open environment, superb voice talent and diverse music. It's a fully 3D experience similar to the PS2 Grand Theft Autos. Amazing visuals, new lighting and shading models & real-time reflections brings you a new epic experience. In Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories brings the GTA action back to Vice City. It's the mid-1980s, just two years before the events in GTA: Vice City. Follow the Vance brothers, Lance and Victor, as they pull themselves out of poverty and try to run the streets. Victor is a 28-year-old US Army soldier who's been kicked out of the service; Lance is a drug addicted wreck. Help them fight for money, power and respect on the hard streets of Vice City. Buy property and set up one of six business at the site - Protection rackets, loan sharking, prostitution, drugs, smuggling and robbery Wild new multiplayer options - Vice City Survivor, the single and multiplayer deathmatch mode; Street racing in new Street Rage; run a Protection Racket; and a crazy new one called Tanks For The Memories Great new radio station playing licensed hits from the 1980s

204085.overview: Gran Turismo Concept is a racing video game of the Gran Turismo series for PlayStation 2 which is developed by Polyphony Digital. It was released in 2002 in Japan, Southeast Asia, Korea, and Europe. The full game was not released in the North American market, although a stripped-down version of it was released in form of Gran Turismo: Nissan 350Z Edition.

204117.overview: With the release of Nissan Micra Roma, Nissan distributed a press kit for each concessionaire in several countries in Europe to promote the car. This press kit included several photographs, a press information booklet and three discs. One of the discs included in this kit is an official Gran Turismo demo named Nissan Micra Edition.

204118.overview: Released in Japan, this edition features the Mitsubishi Airtrek, available to drive in a time-limited race with a selection of two tracks: Autumn Ring and Swiss Alps. Unlike the Copen and 350Z demos, this one doesn't force a one-lap race regardless of the difficulty chosen (Example: Choosing Ace, brings a 5 lap race, like the final version), making any race impossible to finish in both tracks due to the strict, 90-seconds time limit.

204422.overview: This 'special edition' was released in Japan, given to those who leased the Daihatsu Copen in June or July 2002. Looking at the title screen, it's based off the original 2001 Tokyo version. Players drive a Daihatsu Copen for a lap around Autumn Ring. The introduction movie was not used in this version.

204442.overview:
Gravity Sucks is a demo disk featuring WipEout Fusion and AirBlade, first published in the video game event "Games Convention" in 2002. 

AirBlade is a futuristic take on the Tony Hawk franchise in which you control a hovering skateboard called "airblade". Each mission has the player complete certain objectives within in a certain time limit that include destroying cameras or taking out guards using the AirBlade to travel through these areas and discover various items that will help them along the way as well as bonus rooms and missions.

WipEout Fusion is a futuristic racing game in which you race with hovercrafts in the Anti-Gravity Race League. Winning gives you credits that you can use on either upgrading your hovercraft or weapons.

205498.overview: Japan in the 21st century. Similar to human society, waves of IT revolution were coming in the youkai society. It is the spread monster Internet by monster PCs and monster mobile phones. Gegege Forest is no exception and the preaching of the masterpiece father to Kitaro who investigates from a personal computer every day has become everyday. One day, a child sleeping in the park is attacked by thugs. Kitaro, who noticed that the feathers of the falcons had fallen on the spot coincided with the mass abduction of babies a week ago, rushed to the hospital where the abduction occurred. This was the beginning of a major incident involving yokais across Japan.

205499.overview: Gekikuukan Pro Baseball: The End of the Century 1999 is a Sports game, developed and published by SquareSoft, which was released in Japan in 2000.

205500.overview: Gekitou Pro Yakyuu is a Sports game, developed by Wow Entertainment and published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 2003.

207722.overview:
In the late Edo period, humanity is attacked by aliens called "Amanto". The samurai of Japan join the battle against the aliens, but when the Shogun realizes the power of aliens, he betrays the samurai and surrenders to the aliens. The Shogun writes an unequal contract with aliens which allows the aliens to enter the country and places a ban on carrying swords in public. The swords of samurai are taken away so they can no longer resist the aliens. After that the Shogunate becomes a puppet government. The plot is focused on an eccentric samurai, Gintoki Sakata who helps a teenager named Shinpachi Shimura save his sister Tae from a group of aliens who want to make her part of a brothel.

Gintama Gin-San to Issho! Boku no Kabuki Machi Nikki is a visual novel based on the manga with an original storyline divided into 90 short stories and featuring full voice for the characters and different game endings. In some of the episodes the game got some actions sequences in which the player has to press the Circle Button repeatedly, and other mini game sequences.

208715.overview: G1 Jockey 2 is a Sports game, developed by Koei/Inis and published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 2000

210870.overview: Game Select 5 Wa is a Miscellaneous game, published by Yuki, which was released in Japan in 2000.

210924.overview: Golf Paradise DX is a Sports game, published by T&E Soft, which was released in Japan in 2000.

210996.overview: Game Select 5 You is a Miscellaneous game, published by Yuki, which was released in Japan in 2001.

211475.overview: Gakuen Alice is an Adventure game, developed and published by Kids Station, which was released in Japan in 2006.

211478.overview: Gakuen Utopia: Manabi Straight! KiraKira Happy Festa! is an Adventure game, developed and published by Marvelous Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2007.

211479.overview: Game ni Nattayo! Dokuro-chan is an Adventure game, developed and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2005.

213964.overview: The shop demo came in a thin jewelcase with a front insert, which when unfolded shows the controls both for the PS2 controller and GunCon2 controller, and lists the various gameplay modes. The first stages in Arcade and Dungeon modes are playable.

213971.overview: The shop demo came in a thin jewelcase with a booklet.

217128.overview:
The second of two "best hits" PlayStation 2 GuitarFreaks & DrumMania games, featuring a selection of songs that span from GuitarFreaks 5thMIX & DrumMania 4thMix through GuitarFreaks 11thMIX & DrumMania 10thMIX, chosen from surveys by the fans. 

Song ratings reflect arcade ratings as of GuitarFreaks V3 & DrumMania V3. 76 total songs.

219770.overview: The Misterix Mod is a modification for Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. This mod contains many popular myths in GTA San Andreas, such as Bigfoot, Leatherface, and Kifflom. It is infamous for being one of the first myth mods ever released, and many of the creatures featured within have been believed to be real and became myths of their own.

418125.overview:
Project Kaizo is a mod that will allow you to play the story in coop with improvements. Unlike many mods like "Player 2 - Drop In, Drop Out!", you don't need to despawn the second player in every cutscene, red circle, don't need to worry about cars with no seats for second player, and every character can be the second player. 

Includes a reworked cheat menu from PTMG, and the most atractive and unique addition: Mods from PC.

MAIN FEATURES

- Storyline with 2 players
- Compatibility with autosave and previously saved games (on PS2 only with 1.03 versions of NTSC and PAL).
- Restored Hot Coffee for PS3 and X360
- Available for all version in english, spanish and portuguese (only for PS2)
- Creation of respawn at any time (you can create a Imagem, it's a solution for not respawning in the center of the map)
- Second player has a skin selector, and you will appear with him for the rest of the game until you reset
- The health and armor of the second player are constant (if he despawn and spawn he will have his health and armor as before)
- A reworked cheat menu based on PTMG with options compatible with the second player.
- Both players can drive vehicles at the same time
- Mods from PC and Android adapted to console.
- Some mods from PC are compatible with the second player.

OTHER FEATURES

- Accessible interiors like in The Warriors (pressing △/Y and only those necessary for missions)
- Feature "Free us from Softlock" 
- Burglary houses are now avalaible in single player mode
- HUD.txd from PS2 imported to XBOX
- XBOX and PS2 are using Proper Radar.
- NTSC version for PS2 has for default Modern Widescreen mod.
- Some missions are modified to play it correctly with 2 players, like Blood Ring in San Fierro.
- Missions can fail if second player it's busted/wasted, making the experience more natural. 
- Players can give weapons to another one (can be disable in 2-Player Mode-Options).

418691.overview: "God of PES" is a famous, long-running community project that creates fan-made modifications (patches) for Pro Evolution Soccer (PES) games on the PlayStation 2. Originating primarily from the South American community, the God of PES Facebook Group and editing team initially focused heavily on updating the game with authentic Latin American content, particularly the Argentine League (Primera División and Primera B Nacional), South American stadium edits, and local commentary.

419156.overview: Gendai Daisenryaku: Isshoku Sokuhatsu - Gunji Balance Houkai is a Strategy game, developed and published by SystemSoft, which was released in Japan in 2009.

421685.overview: Gaika no Gouhou: Air Land Force is a Strategy game, developed by Koei/Inis and published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 2002.

421930.overview: Generation of Chaos Next is a Strategy game, developed by Neverland and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2002.

421931.overview: Generation of Chaos is a fantasy turn-based strategy RPG franchise developed by Idea Factory that heavily populated the PlayStation 2 console, primarily in Japan. While Western gamers most prominently associate the franchise with its English release on the PlayStation Portable (PSP), the core series actually originated and flourished as a mainstay mainline series on the PS2.

421942.overview:
Fuujin Year 130 (Medieval times when magic and gods were of great importance).
Two years ago, the great war in the "Old Fuujin Continent" was controlled by the "Zenon Country" who possessed great power.

In Randia, a small country to the south, the young prince Alfred is attacked by an assassin but gets saved by his friend Welles. The young prince was the last key to the revival of Randia... It was said that in legends the prince had the power to unleash the "Seal of Power" because of his blood relation. This brought fear upon the Zenon country and thus their attack.

Welles was just another soldier, but he was also a close friend of Alfred's and they had been fighting together in the battlefield for a long time. That is why they're known as the "Galloping Winds" on the battlefield.

And so, the two of them along with Welles' younger sister Teefa, are burdened with the fight for their country. Hearing that war is once again about to break out, the former loyal subject Rea also returns. As more and more people get involved in the war, the mystery of the seal unfolds...

424794.overview: Jiorama Sensen Ijou Nashi: Stalingrad e no Michi is a strategy/sim game with roleplaying overtones, often also referred to as Diorama or Georama. In this simulation RPG, you send tanks out to the battle field to successfully accomplish timed missions. The game's theme is based on World War II's European front. Once you've selected a mission, the game begins on an overhead map as you select destinations for your tanks. The tanks then move automatically, picking up items along the way. You enter battle once your units come in contact with enemy forces.

425883.overview: Gambler Densetsu Tetsuya Digest is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Athena, which was released in Japan in 2004.

425884.overview: Gachinko Pro Yakyuu is a Sports game, developed and published by Now Production, which was released in Japan in 2003.

425887.overview: Gambler Densetsu Tetsuya is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Athena, which was released in Japan in 2001.

425888.overview: Gambler Densetsu Tetsuya: Kurouto Choujou Kessen is a Miscellaneous game, published by Athena, which was released in Japan in 2003.

425891.overview: Gacharoku 2 - Kondo wa Sekai Isshuu yo!!: The second Gacharoku game for PlayStation 2 ditches the Japan-focused theme of the first game to take players on a trip around the world. Like its predecessor, gameplay is based on Japanese Sugoroku board game rules, with more than 70 different mini-games. For four players.

425894.overview:
In Global Folktale, animals have captured the land and humans have retreated to a faraway place. But after years of hiding the time for cowardice is over, as the people stand united and decide to fight back to reclaim what's theirs. Led by Allen, Prince of Zodia Kingdom, players gain control of an eight character party to battle their feral foes in a variety of locations and environments.

Unlike most strategy/RPGs, the combat takes place in real-time with 3D polygonal graphics, while each character is supported by a multitude of customization options, weapons, and items.

425899.overview: Generation of Chaos Desire is a Strategy game, developed and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2007.

425901.overview: The threat of demonic invasion gives impetus to the fledgling Simba Empire to found a school of magic called Vara Noir. With the world recovering after a devastating war, the Empire uses the school to train students in the ways of battle and magic to prepare for any imminent and far-off threats. Enter 13-year old chimney sweeper Myu who cleans smokestacks and other debris laden orifices. One day, her grandpappy hands her a mighty sword and a few ducats and commands her to apply to Vara Noir for an education in the mystic arts. Myu takes the entrance examination and passes with flying colors. As such, she enters Vara Noir academy and goes on an adventure where she will eventually help save the kingdom. Idea Factory's latest game in the Kingdom of Chaos series features dungeon exploration, character interaction and an Megami-Tensei-esque item synthesis system where special items found in dungeons may be bonded with weapons to increase attack power, imbue properties, etc. Interaction sequences are of the point 'n click sort where questions and answers are rattled off in routine fashion. Originally released on the PS2, Gakuen Toshi Vara Noir joins the Gamecube library with new animation sequences and graphical updates which freshen up the adventure for old and new gamers to enjoy.

425904.overview: GetBackers Dakkanya: Ubawareta Mugenjou is an action RPG based on the Manga series GetBackers. You control two characters, Ben and Ginji, who possess special powers that allow them to find and to recover items, valuables, and even people who got lost. Now they are offered a huge sum of money for a recovery job they have to do for a mysterious customer from an even more mysterious Castle of Infinity. The gameplay is based on exploration of randomly generated dungeons. You search for items and also trigger important cut scenes by exploring every corner in the dungeons. The action-based combat resembles a fighting game. You can perform a variety of moves, block your opponent's attack, and switch between the characters. Attacks deplete your stamina bar, so continuously using the strongest attacks is not always the best choice. When your stamina bar is full, you can perform powerful combo attacks.

425906.overview:
The Golf Navigator game series let's the player enjoy a golf simulation where the hallmarks are panoramic 360 degree views of the courses and an intuiative system which allows for proper impartation of power and english to the virtual golfer's swing.

The Vol.1 features 2 courses: Caledonian Golf Club & Sohbu County Club. At the beginning of the game the player can choose between a male or a female caracter, select one of the courses and in each course he can play stroke play, free play or view the course data.

During each hole the player can select the direction, the kind of swing, the stance and how he will face each shot, after selecting all of this he can make the shot.

425907.overview: Gold X is a Strategy game, published by Nippon Amuse, which was released in Japan in 2003.

425908.overview: Gofungo no Sekai - Five Minutes from nowhere is a visual novel divided into 8 chapters (with 7 different main characters but all of their stories are connected) based on Ryu Murakami's novel featuring as usual different endings depending of the player choices during the game. One of the special features that this game got is the time limit action sequences that appears sometimes during each chapter in those sequences the player got a time limit to make an action and advance through the story.

425910.overview:

425916.overview: The story follows Rino Rando, who has been on her own since the passing of her mother, Chieri, as she transfers to Miyagami Private Academy with the recommendation of her mysterious pen pal, Mr. Poppit. Shortly after her arrival, Rino surprisingly becomes a member of elite group of girls called the Best Student Council. Rino learns that Kanade Jinguji founded Miyagami Private Academy as a place where students can live free from restrictions and that the Best Student Council was formed to ensure that freedom. Best Student Council Members receive free tuition, room and board.

425919.overview: A remake of Fanatica for PlayStation 2, with almost all CGs and sprites completely redrawn, a rewritten scenario in a first-person view, with changes in endings and main plot points and new voice acting.

425921.overview:
The Golf Navigator game series let's the player enjoy a golf simulation where the hallmarks are panoramic 360 degree views of the courses and an intuiative system which allows for proper impartation of power and english to the virtual golfer's swing.

425926.overview:
Ore No Ryouri is a Japanese restaurant management simulator, originally released in Japan for the PlayStation on September 9th, 1999. A demo was also included on a PlayStation Underground demo disc as a featured import. A digital version was released on August 20, 2007 on the Japanese PlayStation Store. The player takes the role of a young chef, who must cook his way up through 9 different restaurant levels, cooking a variety of 39 different dishes.

Due to the games popularity it was added to the Best of PlayStation releases in Japan and later a PlayStation 2 party/board game, Gacharoku, was created based on the characters and art style.

Gacharoku is a sugoroku board game that takes its players throughout the country of Japan. Is a board and mini-game action for up to four players.

425934.overview: Gakuen Heaven - Boy's Love Scramble Type B is sort of a Director's Cut of the first game features new scenes, CG & mini games that weren't in the first version of the game.

425939.overview:
The Golf Navigator game series let's the player enjoy a golf simulation where the hallmarks are panoramic 360 degree views of the courses and an intuiative system which allows for proper impartation of power and english to the virtual golfer's swing.

The Vol.2 features 2 courses: Kawagoe Country Club & Shizouka Country Hamaoka Course. At the beginning of the game the player can choose between a male or a female caracter, select one of the courses and in each course he can play stroke play, free play or view the course data.

During each hole the player can select the direction, the kind of swing, the stance and how he will face each shot, after selecting all of this he can make the shot.

425943.overview: Ito Keita, an average high school boy, is surprised to receive an acceptance letter from the renowned Bell Liberty Academy. After being involved in an accident (and luckily, surviving) on the day of his transfer, Keita finds himself among a variety of unique people... but what is Keita's "special ability"? Will he truly be accepted into this school full of elite students?

425944.overview: Gakuen Heaven - Boy's Love Scramble Type B: In the game, the player Keita Ito suddenly received an acceptance letter from the renowned Bell Liberty Academy (also known as BL Gakuen). Attracted by the prestige of the school, he decided to attend. However, on the day of his transfer, the bridge joining the school and the academy, which was located on a remote man-made island, suddenly raised and his bus fell. Luckily, no one was injured but the accident aroused the attention of both the student council's president Niwa Tetsuya as well as the head of the accounting department Saiyonji Kaoru.

425949.overview: Gokuraku Jan Premium is a Puzzle game, published by DigiCube, which was released in Japan in 2003.

425952.overview: Guardian Angel is an Adventure game, developed by Vridge and published by Datam Polystar, which was released in Japan in 2003.

425959.overview:
Guisard Revolution - Bokura wa Omoi o Mi ni Matou: A colorfully garbed team of teenage heroes named Guisard (Blue, Green, Pink, Red, and Yellow) battles secretive evildoers by way of character interaction and nonviolent color-bar duels. Originally released for the Japanese PC in April 2003, developer SandalDash and publisher Kid updates the scenarios in Guisard Revolution, cuts in a host of new cinematic events, and adds PS2 exclusive game modes.

Guisard is a combat subdivision which consists of several young people, which dedicated themselves to daily fight with the demons, which threaten humanity.

425962.overview: Gakkou o Tsukurou!! Happy Days: Is the first game in the series to be released in the Playstation 2 console. This simulation titles makes you the principal of a school, placing you in charge of management and renovating the school grounds.

425976.overview:
Gunparade Orchestra - Midori no Shou is the second part of a PS2 trilogy in the Gun Parade series. The second part of a PS2 trilogy in the Gun Parade series. Gun Parade Orchestra expands on the mech-based battle events of the previous title, utilizing a unique fighting system, AI-controlled characters and freedom to explore your options. Players make use of mechs in battle as they interact with the members of the 108th Security Unit working in Japan's snowy Hokkaido region.

The second salvo in the Gunparade Orchestra trilogy features more escapades at a not-so-average high school where trainees defend the school and the city they're in from invaders known as Genju. The action consists of interactive scenarios, going to class, and 3D run 'n gun action where the player takes direct control of a deft and agile student soldier who's outfitted in a nimble suit of armor.

438250.overview:
Gift (ギフト, Gifuto) is a Japanese adult visual novel developed by Moonstone and released on May 27, 2005, for Windows. The original game was a collaboration project where the company Circus helped to produce it, though Moonstone did the majority of the work involved. Gift is Moonstone's fourth title, and was followed up with an adult fan disc called Gift Rainbow-colored Stories released on January 27, 2006, for Windows. It was later ported to the PlayStation 2 and PlayStation Portable. The gameplay in Gift follows a plot line which offers pre-determined scenarios with courses of interaction, and focuses on the appeal of the five female main characters. The story revolves around Haruhiko Amami, a male high school student living in a town where a rainbow is always seen in the sky.

The game premiered as the second best-selling PC game sold in Japan for the time of its release, and charted in the national top 50 three more times afterwards. A set of five drama CDs, one for each heroine, was released by Lantis between September 2005 and February 2006. There have been six light novels written, a five-chapter illustrated story series that serialized in the Dengeki Hime magazine, two Internet radio shows produced, along with a manga series serialized in Kadokawa Shoten's seinen magazine Comptiq between January 2006 and February 2007. A 12-episode anime adaptation, produced by Oriental Light and Magic, aired in Japan between October and December 2006.

438257.overview: Gunparade Orchestra: Ao no Shou is an Adventure game, developed by Alfa System and published by SCEI, which was released in Japan in 2006.

441384.overview: A collection of Midway arcade games released exclusively in Japan by Success, which contains 32 select games from the original Midway Arcade Treasures and Midway Arcade Treasures 2.

441436.overview: Guts da!! Mori no Ishimatsu is a virtual gambling and simulation video game released exclusively in Japan for the Sony PlayStation 2. Developed and published by the digital entertainment company Aruze Corp, the game launched on 31 March 2005.

441438.overview: 3D beat 'em up by WinkySoft based on the Get Ride! AMDriver anime series

441441.overview: G1 Jockey 4 2006 for the PlayStation 2 is a Japan-exclusive horse racing simulation update released by Koei in September 2006.

441442.overview: G1 Jockey 4 2008 is a horse racing simulation game developed and published by Koei, originally released for the PlayStation 2 in Japan on 18 September 2008. Building upon the mechanics of the original G1 Jockey 4 (2005) and G1 Jockey 4 2007, this specific 2008 edition incorporates updated real-world racing data, rosters, and additional gameplay tweaks.

441447.overview: G1 Jockey 4 2007 is a horse racing simulator developed and published by Koei. It released exclusively in Japan on November 1, 2007, as an updated sequel/expansion to the original G1 Jockey 4 (which launched in 2005/2006).

441453.overview: G1 Jockey 3 is a thoroughbred horse racing simulation game developed and published by Koei for the PlayStation 2, originally released on 27 May 2003. It marks a significant milestone in the franchise as the very first entry in the G1 Jockey series to be localized and officially released in North America.

447283.overview: With an incredible selection of songs and the addictive gameplay that made the Guitar Hero series famous around the world, this game is perfect for those who want to test their musical skills and have fun at the same time. And now, with the Brazucas 3 version, you will have access to an even wider and more diverse repertoire.

448641.overview: This rare version of the game was given out to participants of the Volkswagen Lupo GTI Cup Japan one-make race series. This demo is notable for being the first appearance of Tsukuba Circuit in the series, as the track was never playable in any other version of GT Concept. This demo features the 2000 spec Lupo Cup Car which previously appeared in Gran Turismo 3 (despite the logo in the vehicle selection screen being for the newer 2003 spec model), while the 2003 model would have to wait until version 2 of this demo to make its' debut. Gameplay-wise, this demo is pretty barebones, as upon selecting the Lupo you are taken straight to Tsukuba where you can only do hot laps around the track. The idle replays are the same story.

448760.overview: This is a demo for Gitaroo Man, it was released prior to the full game in Japan. This special PlayStation 2 CD-Rom features the original TGS trailer, alternate recordings of some songs, an art gallery, and a mini-game starring Puma. Each copy of this game came with three collectible cards. With these cards, players could play Gitaroo Man themed janken (Japanese for Paper, Rock, Scissors.)

448783.overview: Gundam True Odyssey: Ushinawareta G no Densetsu (ガンダム・トゥルー・オデッセイ　～失われしＧの伝説～) is a RPG video game published by Bandai released on June 30th, 2005 for the PlayStation 2.

450811.overview:
"A True Definitve" is a modded version of “Grand Theft Auto - San Andreas” containing quality of life improvements including:
 
* Widescreen fix 
* New loading screens
* New water textures, new particles and effects. 
* Smoother vehicle models and reflections
* New weapons
* Small animation changes to add “realism”
* New model for CJ

This project started out as an inside joke to “remaster” this game due to the product released by Rockstar in 2021.

450814.overview:
Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - A True Definitive (Hack)

This is the true finale to the ps2 project. In this final update I have decided to ditch most of the custom textures around the map due to them being low rendered or too dark ruining the feel that I was going for with this mod, however every quality of life changes are still present like the widescreen fix, new tree textures, new loading screens, new water textures, new particles and effects, smoother vehicle models and reflections, new weapons, small animation changes to add “realism”, small texture fixes, new model for CJ, small clothing changes, new timecyc, lighting ect.

What started out as a inside joke to “remaster” this game due to the product we received in 2021, it’s been a great time making this project for everyone to enjoy and i left all the files accessible for anyone to continue where I left off, I would love to see this project evolve and adapt to peoples likings. I only used a 3 applications on my old laptop for this: imgfactory, magic.txd and imgburn, and a Xbox series S for testing through emulation. Thank you everyone for playing this project and have a wonderful day

452874.overview: Spec II is a mod which expands upon the core Gran Turismo 4 experience, bringing a variety of fixes and improvements to the game. As the name may suggest, Spec II primarily aims to improve on the game in ways that Polyphony Digital themselves would, while also adding a few modernised features and challenge run-friendly options.

458559.overview:
It's going to be a day to remember for Sgt Mitchell. His first shift back on the MET's Organised Crime Squad begins with a dawn raid on a council estate that turns nasty. The next 48 hours will put him against the suspicions of his team mates, a new ruthless wave of crime and the most powerful man in London.

Meanwhile on the other side of the city, amateur boxer Eddie O'Conner is in severe trouble. The bank job went horribly wrong, his small-time crew has been wiped out and his only ally in this whole mess is Sam, a teenage thief more comfortable with nicking laptops than gang violence. Eddie knows he's way out of his depth, now his friends are dead and somebody is going to pay...

458609.overview: The game starts in 1936 with a cutscene that shows the death of Johnny Trapani, the father of the main character Aldo Trapani (The sequel confirmed that this is the canon name) and the blowing up of his bakery by the Barzini crime family, one of the Corleones' rivals in New York. In the aftermath, Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando/Bill Melien) comforts the child, telling him that when he is old enough and the time is right he will have his revenge. The story then fastforwards with the 1945 wedding scene in the opening of the film, wherein Aldo's mother asks Don Corleone to look after him, who has been hanging with the wrong crowd. Luca Brasi (Terry McGovern/Gary Chalk) is sent to recruit Aldo and teach him the ways of the Mafia. From this point forward, Aldo is taken under the Corleone Family's wing and works his way up in the organization.

459259.overview: Mod from GTA Vice City PC made by Hellfish Ported to PS2 by Huguito and ZainEsc

464683.overview: Guitar Hero II Deluxe is a fan-made modification of Guitar Hero II. Created by a modding team known as Milohax, Guitar Hero II Deluxe builds upon the foundations laid by Guitar Hero II in order to create an all-around better experience.

465118.overview: A Guitar Hero II ROM Hack mostly comprised of songs from the 70s and 80s.

471862.overview: 2001. The events are taking place at the same time as those of GTA3’s original story. Giovanni Forelli, 26 years old, is the son of Sonny Forelli, also the nephew of the current Forelli patriarch, Giorgio. He was lucky enough to survive the destruction of Little Italy during 1998. The Forelli Family is weak these days, though it still manages to stay in the game. However, a short chain of events and a bit of luck gives the Forellis a chance to restore their power…

474985.overview: Gran Turismo: Lupo Cup Training Version 2 is a rare, promotional demo disc released by Polyphony Digital in 2003 for participants of the Volkswagen Lupo GTI Cup Japan racing series. It features the Volkswagen Lupo GTI Cup Car (J) '03 and takes place at Fuji Speedway.

478085.overview:
1998. A new mafia war begins in Liberty City: the Sindacco, Forelli, and Leone families are ready to tear each other's throats out for power in the city. The Sindaccos, led by the ambitious leader Paulie Sindacco, are going to seize everything they can in the city.

Joseph Daniel O'Toole, a loyal accomplice of the Sindacco family, will try to infiltrate the Leone family in order to destroy it from within. At this time, Paulie's two nephews, Marcus and Frank, are preparing their people for a big war...

482033.overview:
Guitar Hero III: Game Hits is a popular custom PlayStation 2 (PS2) modification/hack that replaces the standard rock soundtrack of Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock with iconic songs and theme music from legendary video games.
The game structures its tracklist into themed career tiers and boss battles, allowing players to shred through nostalgia.

482043.overview:
Developed by Generations Modding this modpack aims to give GTA San Andreas a distinctly Brazilian atmosphere by replacing map textures, music, vehicles, and much more. In addition to low-poly mods converted and adapted from the PC version to the PS2, GTA Generations features many original mods, designed to be lightweight and engaging while accounting for the console's technical limitations.

The mod includes approximately 10 modified weapons, featuring Brazilian-made firearms such as the Taurus M972, the FN FAL, and others.

A total of 110 vehicles have been replaced—an impressive feat for the PS2.

The modpack also incorporates map textures converted from the "TC GTA BRASIL" project, functional speed bumps throughout the map, a helmet mod, new map models, and unique "CLEO" scripts for the PS2—such as police checkpoints, a shop for lowering vehicle suspension, and a shop for installing car audio systems.

Furthermore, some pedestrians have been modified to include famous Brazilian figures—such as Alek, Zoio, and Bolsonaro—as well as characters from popular TV series, including *La Casa de Papel* (Money Heist).

482212.overview: Modified version of Guitar Hero III that features songs from Brazilian bands, such as Capital Inicial, Pitty, Charlie Brown Jr. and Mamonas Assassinas.

482214.overview: Guitar Hero Brazukas 2 is a popular, fan-made PlayStation 2 mod that replaced the game's original international songs with iconic Brazilian rock and pop hits. Featuring native bands like Mamonas Assassinas and Charlie Brown Jr.

482216.overview: Guitar Hero Brazucas IV is a 2021 fan-made spiritual successor launched a decade after the original trilogy ended. Created by a new team of developers as a direct tribute to the original creators, this modification features modernized visuals and an updated tracklist.
